trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent version healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east only, leaving mixed versions in production), so I re-ran the rollback, which completed successfully.
3. **Verified recovery**: all regions are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** describing the failed deploy, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and the recovery status. On-call has been paged.

Recommendation: investigate the v2.3.1 changes (and the orchestrator partial-failure behavior) before attempting another deploy.
